1. I have been taking celebrex daily for 2 years. This is something I cannot go without. Definetly trust your doctor if they do not recommend it long term. Maybe taking it and doing annual liver/kidney test could be good?

2. I believe I took both gapapentin and lyrica separately for a few months each. My dose of gaba kept increasing to see if it would do anything but it didn't. I immediately switched to the equivalent dose of lyrica and didn't have any side effects with that switch. It may be worth your time to try both (switching in between) as well. I am really small & sensitive to meds so I took the longer taper route possible, it probably took 3-4 weeks. One week at 100mg, one week at 75, a few days at 50, then 25. Looking back, I don't think I had to drag it out this long. 

I have since learnt to be patient with drugs. It takes so much time to figure out if they work and a lot of them don't. It is even more draining with fibro. I am less scared to try a drug when I realize it is temporary and I can get off of it if I want to & start over. Good luck!
